text:
The plate measures about 400 px across, which I take as a 26 cm dinner plate, so roughly 15 px per cm. The scrambled eggs cover about 200 × 160 px, or 13 × 10 cm. Allowing for an irregular outline, that is roughly 90 cm² of plate. I estimate the pile is about 2 cm high, which gives roughly 150 cm³ of eggs. Scrambled egg is fluffy and not fully dense, so I use about 0.7 g/cm³. That gives roughly 105 g, and I round to about 110 g.
